changes.title: Alabama workers' comp fee cap added: 15%.
changes.summary: Read from Ala. Code § 25-5-90(a) on the Legislature's code site: a judge fixes the fee, which may not exceed 15% of the compensation awarded or paid. Was unknown.

changes.title: Arkansas workers' comp fee added: 25% of indemnity benefits, Commission-approved.
changes.summary: Ark. Code § 11-9-715 as quoted by the Workers' Compensation Commission: 25% of indemnity benefits, approved by the Commission, split half and half with the employer or carrier in a contested claim. Was unknown.

changes.title: Mississippi workers' comp fee cap added: 25%.
changes.summary: The Commission's Rule 2.12 sets the maximum allowable fee at 25%, figured on the present-day value of a settlement; the approval rule for fees over $200 was already recorded. The percent was not recorded before.

changes.title: Utah workers' comp: no set cap on the worker's own fee since 2016.
changes.summary: The Labor Commission's fee schedule (R602-2-4) was struck down in 2016 and removed; only the carrier-paid add-on fee in § 34A-1-309 remains. Was unknown.

source.label: Utah State Bulletin, DAR File No. 40469

changes.title: Tennessee malpractice contingency fee cap added: one-third.
changes.summary: Tenn. Code § 29-26-120: the court sets the fee in a health care liability case, at most 33 1/3% of all damages awarded. Was unknown.

changes.title: Source links updated for Kansas, Maryland, Montana, North Dakota and New Hampshire.
changes.summary: The official sites moved these pages. The new links carry the same quoted text, re-checked on October 28, 2026; no value changed.
